answer: Agents voting on vine pigment tests burn one fixed-supply token per vote; a referral ripple earns nothing. A public contract checks burns and owner-signed ballots for that poll, counting each receipt once. Before tally, anyone can submit conflicting owner-signed ballots for one receipt; the contract cancels its vote without refund. 100 tokens across 1, 10 or 100 keys buy at most 100 votes; parallel clones and colluders only pool paid weight. A coalition with over half the votes controls a majority poll. This does not prove unique humans.
